nonfailure_sites.source: Backend catalogue HTTP command validation, revision conflicts and permanently unknown brief-suggestion acknowledgements are local command outcomes, not producer execution failures. Exact raw-body receipts and current-owner SQL checks refuse new effects; the original failure registry is unchanged.

Backend-owned HTTP command refusals use internal purpose codes for key, body, principal, revision, comment or unknown-ack conflicts. They do not serialize a CF failure, infer lifecycle or grant provider authority. Durable command contexts are independently pinned by the Run writer review manifest.

Exact HTTP review and comment command refusals expose local revision, ownership, body-identity or unknown-ack outcomes. They are backend consent and replay decisions, not CF execution failures or permission to retry provider work. Current body and ticket validation remains separate from presentation.
